provider_receipt.summary: Review completed read-only. The joined completion is not supported by the supplied evidence: the only declared check proves a clean tree, not compilation, tests, or objective behavior, while both close receipts contain no implementation or behavioral verification details. Named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits wikilinks containing absolute paths or `..` components to resolve outside the private vault, exposing existence and paths of external files; (2) src/lib.rs:106-125 scans every Markdown file and assigns semantic-memory treatment without enforcing the classification, authority, status, privacy, quarantine, or review requirements in docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md; (3) src/lib.rs:56-89 serializes each MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so the claimed persistent-memory ingestion does not persist anything; (4) NoteFrontmatter at src/lib.rs:13-25 implements a legacy schema incompatible with the documented required ingestion metadata, including a numeric confidence field instead of low/medium/high; (5) Cargo.toml:13-14 depends on crates outside the supplied project root, so this bounded review cannot establish that the implementation builds against its dependencies. No files were modified and no artifacts were created.
